title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: The ROC curve is a graphical representation of the true positive rate (TPR) against the false positive rate (FPR) at various threshold settings. It helps evaluate the performance of a binary classifier.

title: Calculating TPR and FPR
text: To calculate the true positive rate (TPR), use the formula: TPR $$=$$ true positives / (true positives + false negatives). For the false positive rate (FPR), use: FPR $$=$$ false positives / (false positives + true negatives).
